serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I hear police sirens…
As if out of spite, this time their reaction time is faster than expected. 
My head is spinning uncontrollably, if they see me, it’s over. My whole body is covered in blood.
Because of my nausea, I can’t even pinpoint from which directions the sounds of the chase are coming. Are they behind me? No. From the left?
It’s over for me…
I-I need to call someone for help.
Big Daddy!{{wi}} No, he won’t help me this time.
DAK!
You: Pick up! Pick up!
DAK: What is it? You shouldn’t be calling this number!
You: I did it! I killed him! 
DAK: Haha! Really?!
You: You need to help me though. The police are after me. They are going to get me.
DAK: Sorry buddy, you are on your own.
You: What?! It was your idea!
DAK: Listen! I need to get to Admin’s base as soon as I get the access codes! Your sacrifice won’t be in vain.
DAK: And please, destroy your phone. You wouldn’t want them to get to me next, right?
You: Fuck you! Help me!
You: Hello? Hello?!
Dammit! He hung up!
I can hear them closing on me! It’s over…
There’s nothing more I can do. I really fucked up this time.
I need to call one more person…
